## Executive Corporate Overview
Icon Drugs Private Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical enterprise established in 2002 in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The company specializes in the formulation, manufacturing, and distribution of prescription pharmaceuticals across chronic and acute therapeutic segments. Operating in licensed facilities adhering to national pharmacopeial standards (IP/BP/USP), Icon Drugs supplies medicines to primary healthcare providers, government healthcare schemes, hospitals, and ethical PCD franchise partners across India.

## Key Product Brands & Formulations
- Neurology & Neuropathic Pain: Prenerve Caps (Pregabalin + Methylcobalamin), Prenerve-NT (Pregabalin + Nortriptyline), Prenerve Forte, Prenerve Inj, Prenerve Gel.
- Orthopedics & Musculoskeletal Care: APAR range (Aceclofenac + Paracetamol ± Serratiopeptidase / Thiocolchicoside), CT-Flam (Enzyme formulation), Serek-D, Serek-DP, Serek-N.
- Gastroenterology: Pandom / Pandom-SR (Pantoprazole + Domperidone), Rabicon / Rabicon-L (Rabeprazole + Levosulpiride).
- Respiratory & Pulmonology: Recoff Syrup, Recoff-DX Syrup (Dextromethorphan + Phenylephrine + CPM), Allerkast Tablets (Levocetirizine + Montelukast).
- Bone Health & Mineral Metabolism: Precal Softgel (Calcitriol + Calcium Carbonate + Zinc + K2-7), Precal-D.
- Anti-Infectives & Urology: Nitobact-SR (Nitrofurantoin SR 100 mg), Ocon-OZ (Ofloxacin + Ornidazole), Dermicon-BN Cream.
- Nutritional & Vitality Support: Argicon Tab / Sachet (L-Arginine), Fobiron (Ferrous Ascorbate + Folic Acid), Lycotox (Antioxidants + Multivitamins).
